cross_item_rule: Partial, and weak. On the transition items the only thing that fired was 'eliminate the lone temporal or conditional adverbial in an otherwise logical set' (By then, Beforehand, In the meantime, Until then, Earlier, Otherwise x2, In one case) - it fired on 8 of 13 transitions and never got past eliminating one option, so it took me from 4 legal to 3 and no further. It is a distractor-authoring habit, not a solvable tell. On the notes items the one rule that did real work was 'two options that assert the same thing in different words are both distractors' - it fired once cleanly (item 10, where B and D both say the rise is late-loaded) and gave the only confident pick in the set. Subject knowledge eliminated exactly two options once (item 19, dung-to-voids vs grog-to-inclusions) and then stalled, because the two survivors are both true statements and only the withheld notes choose between them. Everything else was a coin flip among 4.
shared_frames: Yes, three groupings, and none of them leak across items. (a) The pure-crossed numeric notes items - 1, 3, 5, 18, 21 - share one frame: an identical sentence with one or two numeric slots varied, and where two attributes vary they are fully crossed 2x2 (18: count x thickness; 21: device x leaf count; 13: fastest setting x clouded setting). Recognising the frame tells you the item is un-guessable, which is the correct behaviour, not a leak. (b) The shape-of-a-trend items - 10, 17 - share a frame where the endpoints are held identical across all four options and only the intermediate trajectory varies (front-loaded / back-loaded / uniform / delayed). Solving 10 taught me to look for redundant-paraphrase pairs in 17, but 17 has none, so the transfer produced nothing. (c) The compound-fact items - 6, 19, 13 - pair a figure with a second attribute (which plant, which mechanism, which setting) and cross them; only 19 is partly decidable, and only because the mechanism half is a real-world fact rather than a datum from the source. Solving any one of these does not help with any other.
